>第三方提供公司信息及邮箱后, 我方会根据公司信息生成签名秘钥并发送到指定的邮箱中

* 签名方式: `RSA` 根据提供的签名信息进行对接
* appKey: 签名key
* secret: 签名秘钥

### 测试数据

* RSA
  * appKey: 9017ab23f8dd4c17bb9f837ccf1813c3
  * secret: 

### 请求方式

> 支持GET POST接口的签名。 Header中增加以下三个字段： 

* `appKey` 签名key
* `timestamp`  当前时间毫秒值
* `signature` 签名信息

### 示例

* 时间戳  1753863125742

GET

```
http://host:port/get?query=a&state=b&mark=c
```

data = `base64(query=a&state=b&mark=c)` = `cXVlcnk9YSZzdGF0ZT1iJm1hcms9Yw==`

POST

```js
http://host:port/post

{"query":"a","state":"b","mark":"c"}
```

data = `base64({"query":"a","state":"b","mark":"c"})` = `eyJxdWVyeSI6ImEiLCJzdGF0ZSI6ImIiLCJtYXJrIjoiYyJ9`

### RSA签名信息生成

* 将data和timestamp使用Unicode编码排序 `data=cXVlcnk9YSZzdGF0ZT1iJm1hcms9Yw==&timestamp=1753863125742`
* 使用 `secret` 作为私钥进行 `SHA256withRSA` 进行签名
* signature=上述签名结果

### 示例

```java
// post - rsa
JSONObject jsonObject = new JSONObject();
jsonObject.put("query", "a");
jsonObject.put("state", "b");
jsonObject.put("mark", "c");
Map<String, Object> param = new TreeMap<>();
param.put("data", Base64.encode(jsonObject.toJSONString()));
param.put("timestamp", 1753863125742L);
String buildQuery = URLUtil.buildQuery(param, CommonConstant.CHARSET);
Sign sign = SignUtil.sign(SignAlgorithm.SHA256withRSA, "", null);
String signature = sign.signHex(buildQuery);

// get - md5
Map<String, Object> param = new TreeMap<>();
param.put("secret", "kFAcGBWbXEtKhiGMzeTFMLUVUixqR7MyqtxBtE2Z4YUNhqaNgpzNuWcuLpR523bh");
param.put("data", Base64.encode("query=a&state=b&mark=c"));
param.put("timestamp", 1753863125742L);
String buildQuery2 = URLUtil.buildQuery(param, CommonConstant.CHARSET);
Sign sign = SignUtil.sign(SignAlgorithm.SHA256withRSA, "", null);
String signature = sign.signHex(buildQuery2);
```
